tagline.en_US: Store notes as Markdown files, search and tag them from a responsive web interface. Authentication is configured during installation.

description.en_US: Flatnotes is a self-hosted note-taking web application that uses a flat folder of markdown files for storage without relying on a database. It provides a clean, distraction-free interface featuring raw and WYSIWYG editing modes, note tagging, and full-text search. Because notes are stored as standard markdown files, you can access and edit them with other applications at any time.
